Ask your manager for your restaurant code.
Location is checked only when you start or finish a shift. Your restaurant uses the result to verify attendance.

Your login, shifts, requests and team messages are handled by the restaurant workspace. Only when you tap Start shift or Finish shift, the app requests precise location to verify on-site attendance. A location check and server-recorded work time may be stored and reviewed by authorized restaurant managers. There is no background location tracking. Ask your employer for its full employee privacy notice, retention periods and data protection contact.
